text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups. Fairness means making sure AI treats everyone equally. Privacy is also a key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. People need to know how their data is used. Transparency helps here: companies should explain how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means creating technology that respects human rights and values. Developers, governments, and users must work together to ensure AI benefits everyone and does not cause harm.
